missing_stage: transfer across systems patient understanding supply prescribing equity subgroup access and long-run outcome

source_title: Lancet Surgisphere hydroxychloroquine registry analysis and retraction
unit_or_scope: multinational observational registry claim affecting COVID-19 treatment decisions
stage: publication failure correction and institutional learning
direct_observation: Paper was published then retracted after authors could not complete an independent audit; WHO temporarily halted its hydroxychloroquine trial arm while evidence was reviewed
missing_stage: downstream clinical or policy harm time-to-correction visibility affected populations and remedy
evidence_status: high for named integrity failure and correction; low for harm accounting
next_test: trace original publication decision suspension retraction notice visibility and subsequent policy or trial correction

unit_or_scope: 193 experiments from 53 high-impact cancer-biology papers with 50 replications completed
direct_observation: Registered protocols were peer-reviewed before data collection; data code and materials were open; replication effect sizes were 85% smaller on average and 46% met more criteria than they failed
closed_stage: independent replication preregistration and transparency mechanism
missing_stage: clinical or policy uptake correction reach original-author response cost equity and decision effect
evidence_status: high for reproducibility evidence; medium for methodological interpretation; low for downstream decision
next_test: follow one replicated claim through open data review correction citation and any clinical or policy use
